cumleler: Can hearing loss lower a cognitive screening score?
Common screens like the Montreal Cognitive Assessment, MoCA, take about ten minutes.
But most of these tests rely on spoken instructions.
Someone who misses a question and answers wrongly scores low.
A personal amplifier, a quiet room and written instructions reduce this error.
Screening is not diagnosis; suspicious results lead to referral, with consent.
